opportunities.title: APEX Awards

amount.raw: Applicants can apply for up to £200,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Established independent researchers with a strong track record, holding a permanent or fixed-term position covering the award duration, based in a UK university or UK not-for-profit research organisation, with teaching and admin duties from which they can be relieved. Up to two Co-applicants covering a different Academy remit.
opportunities.summary: Academies Partnership in Supporting Excellence in Cross-disciplinary research: offers established independent researchers an opportunity to pursue genuine interdisciplinary and curiosity-driven research to benefit wider society, collaborating across science, engineering, and the social sciences and humanities.

opportunities.title: SHAPE Involve and Engage
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Any researcher based in the UK who meets the conditions of the call; previous successful recipients of the award are not eligible to reapply.
opportunities.summary: Public engagement programme supporting ambitious projects to engage the public with humanities and social sciences research, working in partnership with a gallery, archive, library or museum (GLAM) or performing arts organisation.

opportunities.title: The Alexander von Humboldt Foundation and The British Academy Knowledge Frontiers Symposium 2027

amount.raw: The symposium covers travel, accommodation, and visa costs

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Early career researchers affiliated with research institutions in the UK or Germany in the humanities and social sciences.
opportunities.summary: Call for early career scholars in the humanities and social sciences to attend a research collaboration symposium on the theme 'Humans and Nature: More resilient towards the future', in partnership with the Alexander von Humboldt Foundation. Seed funding available for international collaborations.

opportunities.title: Postdoctoral Fellowships

amount.raw: Academy funds 80 per cent of salary costs, directly allocated and indirect costs under FEC; three year award

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Early-career researchers in the humanities and social sciences based at an eligible UK university or research organisation. British citizens and EEA nationals eligible regardless of where the doctorate was obtained; any nationality with a UK doctorate; or strong prior association with the UK academic community. Must have completed Viva Voce between 1 April 2024 and 1 April 2027. No permanent academic post held.
opportunities.summary: Three-year fellowship for outstanding early-career researchers in the humanities or social sciences to pursue an independent research project towards completion of a significant piece of publishable research.

opportunities.title: Talent Development Awards 2026-27
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Established researchers in the humanities and social sciences ordinarily resident in the UK, holding a current long-term appointment at a UK-based HEI or IRO continuing for the full duration of the award. Independent researchers without institutional affiliation are not eligible.
opportunities.summary: Awards to promote the acquisition and advancement of skills in relevant areas (quantitative skills, data science, digital humanities, languages) by UK-based researchers, supporting innovative research methods through skills development, collaboration or dissemination.

opportunities.title: International Interdisciplinary Research Projects 2027

amount.raw: The total funding available per award in this call is up to £300,000 over 2 years

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Principal Investigator must be a researcher from the humanities and social sciences based at an eligible UK university or research institute, of postdoctoral or above status (or equivalent), holding an established role lasting at least the award duration, spending at least 20% time on the award. Co-Applicants based overseas required. Collaboration across disciplines required.
opportunities.summary: Supports UK-led international interdisciplinary research in the humanities and social sciences on the theme of Mobilities (movement of people, things and ideas), collaborating with international partners across SHAPE and STEM disciplines.

opportunities.title: Global Innovation Fellowships: The German Council on Foreign Relations (DGAP) 2026-27

amount.raw: awards for up to £150,000 for 12 months in duration (with Full Economic Costing at 80 per cent)

opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK-based early- and mid-career researchers from across the humanities and social sciences.
opportunities.summary: Fellowships providing opportunities for UK-based early- and mid-career researchers in the humanities and social sciences to develop their skills, networks and careers by embedding in the office of the German Council on Foreign Relations (DGAP) in Berlin, in areas including security/defence/resilience, Indo-European relations, technology and AI, and strategy-making in Europe.

opportunities.title: Additional Needs

amount.raw: applicants may apply for funding of up to £4,000; exceptional cases above £4,000 considered

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Current British Academy award-holders on any scheme OR applicants intending to apply for a British Academy award in the next six months.
opportunities.summary: Specific funding to support additional needs that applicants and award-holders may require (e.g. specific equipment to overcome barriers for disabled researchers, caring costs for research trips, assistance for applicants with sensory impairment, support in making an application), reviewed on a rolling, case-by-case basis.
